sources.summary: Casa Meyra is an exploration of restraint. A house that, without expanding in an overt way, finds in volumetry and materiality the tools to build depth, character, and a clear presence from the outside. The project is defined by a precise architecture, where each decision seems to respond more to spatial clarity than to the pursuit of a dominant gesture.
